locale.description: Do not translate. The language code of this file, used to format numbers and times.

dir.description: Do not translate. ltr, or rtl for right-to-left languages.

ext_name.message: Coddy Focus: Website Blocker and Focus Timer
ext_name.description: Store and extension name, at most 75 characters. Keep 'Coddy Focus' as is.

ext_description.message: Block distracting sites, set daily limits and focus. Free, open source, your data stays in your browser. Learn to code on Coddy.

learn_on_coddy.description: Link to coddy.tech, a site to learn coding.

incognito_off.message: Blocking is off in incognito windows. To turn it on, open the extension's page and switch on incognito access.

popup_lockdown_until.description: {time} is a time like 17:30 or Mon 09:00.

popup_focus_body.message: Your sites are blocked until the timer ends.

popup_break_body.message: Take a short break. Your usual limits apply.

popup_focus_start.description: Button that starts a focus session. {duration} is a length like 25 minutes.

popup_empty_title.message: Add the sites that distract you

popup_empty_body.message: Then choose how much time you get on them each day.

popup_off_title.message: Your limits are off right now

popup_off_body.description: {time} is a time like 17:30 or Mon 09:00.

popup_blocked_body.message: Every site on your list is always blocked.

popup_used_up_midnight.message: Your sites open again at midnight.

popup_site_not_listed.description: {site} is a site address like youtube.com.

popup_site_listed_limited.description: {site} is a site address like youtube.com.

popup_site_listed_blocked.description: {site} is a site address like youtube.com.

options_title.description: Browser tab title. Keep 'Coddy Focus' as is.

sites_add_placeholder.description: Example addresses. Keep the addresses as they are.

sites_empty.message: No sites yet. Add the ones you lose time on.

sites_invalid.message: That doesn't look like a site address.

sites_duplicate.message: That site is already on your list.

sites_remove_label.description: Screen reader label. {site} is a site address.

access_basic.message: Coddy Focus has no access to this site, so it can't count your time there. When the site is blocked, you see the browser's plain blocked page instead of Coddy's.

access_missing.message: Some sites have no access. Time on them isn't counted, and when they're blocked they show the browser's plain blocked page.

allowance_body.message: All your daily time limit sites share this time. Set 0 to block them all day.

minutes_per_day.description: Follows a number field, as in '30 minutes a day'.

focus_body.message: Every site on your list is blocked while you work, then you get a break.

lockdown_body.message: Blocks every site on your list for as long as you choose. You can't stop it once it starts.

lockdown_confirm.description: Confirm button. {duration} is a length like '4 hours'.

lockdown_active.description: {time} is a time like 17:30 or Mon 09:00.

hide_body.message: Keep a site open but hide the parts that pull you in.

strict_enable.message: Make looser limits wait until tomorrow

strict_body.message: Stricter limits apply right away. Removing a site, raising your time or turning strict mode off takes effect at midnight.

pending_strict.message: Strict mode is on, so changes that loosen your limits take effect at midnight.

pending_lockdown.message: A lockdown is on, so changes that loosen your limits take effect {time}.
pending_lockdown.description: {time} is a time like 17:30 or Mon 09:00.

backup_body.message: Save your settings to a file, or load them from one.

backup_invalid.message: That file is not a Coddy Focus backup.

about_body.message: Coddy Focus makes no network requests and keeps everything in your browser. Anyone can read the code.

blocked_title.description: {site} is a site address like youtube.com.

blocked_reason_lockdown.description: {time} is a time like 17:30 or Mon 09:00.

blocked_reason_focus.message: You're in a focus session. {time} left.

blocked_reason_blocked.description: {time} is a time like 17:30 or Mon 09:00.

blocked_reason_limit.message: You used today's time. It opens again {time}.

blocked_reason_limit_midnight.message: You used today's time. It opens again at midnight.

blocked_pitch.message: One short coding lesson on Coddy beats ten minutes of scrolling.

blocked_open_title.description: {site} is a site address like youtube.com.

today_no_time.message: No time counted yet. Only sites on your list are counted, and only on this device.

nav_label.description: Screen reader name of the settings tab list.

toast_saved_later.message: Saved. Changes that loosen your limits take effect later.

focus_then_break.description: Under the focus timer. {duration} is a length like 5 minutes.

sites_access_denied.message: {site} wasn't added. Coddy Focus needs access to it to count your time and show its blocked page.
sites_access_denied.description: Shown when the user denies Chrome's access prompt. {site} is a site address.

focus_hint.message: Blocks every site on your list until the timer ends, then gives you a short break. You can stop it anytime.

lockdown_hint.message: Blocks every site on your list for as long as you choose. It can't be stopped early.

mode_limited_hint.message: These sites share your daily time. When it runs out, they're blocked until midnight.

mode_blocked_hint.message: Blocked all day, or only during the hours you set under Limits.
